blocks.text: Discover the wild landscapes of Mato Grosso, where the wetlands of the Northern Pantanal meet the crystal-clear rivers of Nobres and the dramatic scenery of Chapada dos Guimarães. Experience boat safaris and wildlife encounters in one of South America’s great wildernesses, followed by refreshing river adventures and spectacular waterfalls before returning to Cuiabá.
